```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```


#3. define your control group (level of treatment that matches key above)
```{r}
control_group <- "paired female"
```

#4. define project / sample name 
```{r}
project_name <- "singleparent-pits-d5"
```

#5. [OPTIONAL] if you want to normalize to specific reference genes, list names here
```{r}
custom_refgenes <- c("hprt1", "rpl4")
```

#6. Clean then generate log_fold change data
######################################################################
```{r}
#load packages
#use pacman to install and load all packages required
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") #install pacman if not already installed
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dplyr,broom,naniar)

#source functions
source("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/codeANDdatasets_Chapter2and3/qpcr_processing_functions_NOCHANGE.R")

#clean and join data 
colnames(raw_data) <- tolower(colnames(raw_data))
raw_data2 <- 
  raw_data %>%
  mutate(gene = tolower(gene)) %>% #all lowercase genes 
  replace_with_na(replace = list(gene = "")) %>% #blank to NA
  drop_na(gene) 

#join with project key 
#adds treatment group for normalizing expression 

colnames(key) <- tolower(colnames(key))

dat_joined <- inner_join(raw_data2, key) #joins by "sample"

#clean triplicates
dat_clean <- clean_triplicates(dat_joined)

#average cq across triplicates (returns 1 avg cq value for each sample:gene)
dat_avg <- avg_triplicates(dat_clean)
```
#7. get dct values.
```{r}
#get average reference gene and dct
dat_dct <- 
  dat_avg %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(is_ref = ifelse(gene %in% reference_genes, 1, 0),
         ref_gene = mean(mean_cq[gene %in% custom_refgenes], na.rm = T)) %>% #get average reference gene
  mutate(dct = mean_cq - ref_gene) #calculate dct
# make subset for 449
dat_449 <- subset(dat_dct, sample == 449) # copy and paste the dct values when determining ddct for step #9
```


#8 get Rq_norm values
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_gr <- subset(dat_dct, gene == "gr")

# subtract one paired dct control from all the treatment groups
dat_ddct <-
  dat_gr %>% 
  mutate(ddct = dct - 4.192441) # using paired female 449


# get fold change (rq)
dat_qpcr <- 
  dat_ddct %>%
  group_by(sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(rq = 2^-(ddct)) %>%
  ungroup()

#get dataframe of controls 
control_genes <- 
  dat_qpcr %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(control_rq = mean(rq[treatment == control_group], na.rm = T)) # control = average rq for vehicle group

#join with control data by genes
dat_ddct_controls <- left_join(dat_qpcr, control_genes) #joins by gene

# FINAL PRODUCT: normalize rq, get log(rq_norm)
dat_gr_qpcr_final <- 
  dat_ddct_controls %>%
  group_by(sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(rq_norm = rq/control_rq,
         log_fold = log(rq_norm)) %>%
  ungroup()

#add sex category
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "male"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "male"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "female"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "female"

# add nest type category
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "single parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "single parent"
```

### Data Analysis
### Confirm Rq for ref sample is 1
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_gr_449 <- subset(dat_gr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_mr_449 <- subset(dat_mr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_prlr_449 <- subset(dat_prlr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_prl_449 <- subset(dat_prl_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_oxtr_449 <- subset(dat_oxtr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_vipr_449 <- subset(dat_vipr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
```
# rq values 1 or close to 1! 

#confirm reference genes 
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_ref <- subset(dat_dct, gene == "rpl4")
#add sex category
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "paired male"] <- "male"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "single male"] <- "male"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "paired female"] <- "female"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "single female"] <- "female"

# add nest type category
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "single male"] <- "single"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "single female"] <- "single"
```
# incorporating key info again 
```{r}
dat_ref <- left_join(dat_ref, key, by = c("sample","treatment"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(aes(y = ref_gene ,x = treatment, fill= treatment), data = dat_ref) + geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Refgene Expression", x="", y="ref gene Cq") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ treatment, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ brood, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
# so rank-transform test better
```{r}
lmer_ref <- lmer(rank(ref_gene) ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_ref, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_ref, type = "II", test = "F")
```
#so no significant difference between treatment groups in regards to reference genes. 
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_ref, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# by nest type and sex?
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ type, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ sex, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
# so rank-transform test better (for sex)
```{r}
fit_ref_s <- aov(rank(ref_gene) ~ type*sex, data = dat_ref)
Anova(fit_ref_s, type = "II")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_ref_s, type = "II"))
```
# so no significant difference by treatment, nest-type, or sex! :)

### PRLR 
```{r}
dat_prlr_qpcr_final <- left_join(dat_prlr_qpcr_final, key, by = c("sample","treatment"))
```

```{r}
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired father"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired mother"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
```

```{r}
my_t_prlr <- expression(bold("Pituitary" ~ paste(bolditalic("PRLR"))))
prlr <- ggplot(aes(y = rq_norm,x = treatment, fill= treatment), data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent) +
  labs(title = my_t_prlr,subtitle = "", x="", y="fold change to paired mothers") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5)) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired mother", "paired father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(3.2), textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single mother", "paired father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(3.2), textsize = 9)+ ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired father", "single father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(3.8), textsize = 9) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother", "paired father", "single mother", "single father"))+ ylim(0,4.5)
prlr
```
# will remove paired mother (1) and single father (2) outliers
```{r}
#remove outliers
dat_prlr_qpcr_final <- dat_prlr_qpcr_final[-c(7,50,49), ]
```

```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ brood, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so rank transform better 
```{r}
lmer_prlr <- lmer(rank(rq_norm) ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_prlr, type = "II", test = "F")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_prlr, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# so significant difference between treatment groups.
# post-hoc analysis:
```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(lmer_prlr, list(pairwise ~ treatment), adjust="tukey") 
```

## Cohen's d analysis
#subsets of treatment groups
```{r}
pmom <- dat_prlr_qpcr_final[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired mother",] #12
pfath <- dat_prlr_qpcr_final[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired father",] #15
smom <- dat_prlr_qpcr_final[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single mother",] #13
sfath <- dat_prlr_qpcr_final[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single father",] #8
```
# paired fathers vs paired mothers
```{r}
pfath_v_pmom <- full_join(pfath,pmom)
cohens_d(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = pfath_v_pmom)
```
# paired fathers vs single mothers
```{r}
pfath_v_smom <- full_join(pfath,smom)
cohens_d(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = pfath_v_smom)
```
# paired fathers vs single fathers
```{r}
pfath_v_sfath <- full_join(pfath,sfath)
cohens_d(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = pfath_v_sfath)
```
# so a significant difference between paired fathers versus paired mothers and single mothers, but not single fathers when include brood size. What if brood size is removed as a co-variable?
# with brood size removed
```{r}
lmer_prlr_nob <- lmer(rank(rq_norm) ~ treatment+(1 | nestid), data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_prlr_nob, type = "II", test = "F")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_prlr_nob, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# so significant difference between treatment groups.
# post-hoc analysis:
```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(lmer_prlr_nob, list(pairwise ~ treatment), adjust="tukey") 
```
# so also a significant difference between paired fathers and single fathers if remove brood size as co-variable (and there is no significant difference in terms of brood size for PRLR, anyways.).
# nest type and sex
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ type, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ sex, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so rank transform better 
```{r}
fit_prlr_s <- aov(rank(rq_norm) ~ type*sex, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final)
Anova(fit_prlr_s, type = "II")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_prlr_s, type = "II"))
```
# so also significant difference by nest-type and sex.

```{r}
  labs(title = my_t_prl,subtitle = "", x="", y="fold change to paired mothers") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother", "paired father", "single mother", "single father")) +  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single mother", "paired mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(1.65), textsize = 9) + ylim(0,2)
prl
```
```{r}
my_t_prl <- expression(bold("Pituitary" ~ paste(bolditalic("PRL"), ~ "by nest-type")))
prl_s <- ggplot(aes(y = rq_norm,x = type, fill= type), data = dat_prl_qpcr_final) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent_pool) +
  labs(title = my_t_prl,subtitle = "", x="", y="fold change to paired mothers") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 1, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5)) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single parent", "paired parent")), map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 9) + ylim(0,2)
prl_s
```
# will remove single female (1) outlier
```{r}
dat_prl_qpcr_final <- dat_prl_qpcr_final[-c(35), ]
```

```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ brood, data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so parametric tests ok
```{r}
lmer_prl <- lmer(rq_norm ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_prl, type = "II", test = "F")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_prl, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
#so no significant difference by treatment groups when brood size included. 

# what if drop brood size?
```{r}
lmer_prl_nob <- lmer(rq_norm ~ treatment+(1 | nestid), data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_prl_nob, type = "II", test = "F")
```

```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(lmer_prl_nob, list(pairwise ~ treatment), adjust="tukey") 
```
# now a significant difference between paired mothers and single mothers. 

## Cohen's d analysis
#subsets of treatment groups
```{r}
pmom <- dat_prl_qpcr_final[dat_prl_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired mother",] #13
pfath <- dat_prl_qpcr_final[dat_prl_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired father",] #15
smom <- dat_prl_qpcr_final[dat_prl_qpcr_final$treatment == "single mother",] #12
sfath <- dat_prl_qpcr_final[dat_prl_qpcr_final$treatment == "single father",] #10
```
#paired mothers vs single mothers
```{r}
pmom_v_smom <- full_join(pmom,smom)
cohens_d(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = pmom_v_smom)
```
# nest type and sex
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ type, data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ sex, data = dat_prl_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so parametric tests ok
```{r}
fit_prl_s <- aov(rq_norm ~ type*sex, data = dat_prl_qpcr_final)
Anova(fit_prl_s, type = "II")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_prl_s, type = "II"))
```
# so significant difference by nest-type in general, with single parents expressing less PRL in the pituitary than paired parents overall.
